description:
Deletes an avatar from a project, issue type or priority.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the item the avatar is associated with.
parameters.name: owningObjectId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to delete the avatar, the avatar is not deletable.

404.description: Returned if the avatar type, associated item ID, or avatar ID is invalid.
